title: Rizzstack Rails HTTP contract — rizzstack.rails-http/1
$comment: R01 freeze candidate. Describes the routes, error envelope, wire objects and limits of the Rails HTTP surface (spec sections 7 and 10). routes and transport_rules are document data; error_envelope, append_request, append_response, export_page and limits are schemas the wire objects must satisfy. Every route requires an existing credential from the configured store, including health; read and mutation credentials are distinct entries and are never printed or echoed. Unexpected Host headers, credentials in URL query strings, redirects and cross-origin calls are refused. Requests carry bounded Content-Length and application/json UTF-8; chunked upload and invalid or negative lengths are refused. Errors never leak tracebacks or paths.

items.$comment: each record must satisfy rizzstack.rails-candidate/1 from source.schema.json

append_request.$comment: Worker export batches carry original hashed envelopes and must use the import path rather than re-authoring them; the service routes batches by authenticated producer capability, never by a client-supplied authority label.

append_response.$comment: Same dedupe key with same semantic bytes returns the original receipt with duplicate=true; same key with different bytes is a 409 conflict.

items.$comment: original canonical envelope bytes, never re-authored

export_page.$comment: Origin cursor is numeric and exclusive. Invalid cursors are refused; a cursor beyond the head reports reset_required; a missing retained prefix reports source_gap. Initial replication verifies from genesis or an explicitly trusted checkpoint supplied through owner configuration.

limits.$comment: Proposed request cap 1 MiB; feedback cap 8 KiB; at most 8 concurrent streams with a 1 MiB buffer per stream. Slow stream clients are dropped with reconnect instructions and never block writers. Reverse proxy timeouts and connection caps apply in addition.

routes.behavior: revisions, schema digest, last import, integrity range, source status, clock and coverage warnings; no private paths
validated selector and cursor query, read-only
safe presentation JSON (rizzstack.rails-view/1) for the same selector and cursor under the same result metadata and caps; format parameter is ignored
authorized server-sent events with selector and Last-Event-ID replay; no ingestion side effect
same authorized filter, paginated bounded feedback and intervention projection as csv or jsonl
producer-authenticated atomic candidate batch; never exposed through the browser proxy
trusted owner route only; fixed feedback schema and idempotency key
trusted authorized action submission; delegates to the existing queue and never executes shell or session mutation in the server

transport_rules: every route, including health, requires an existing credential from the configured store
read and mutation credentials are distinct store entries and are never printed, echoed or logged
unexpected Host headers, credentials in URL query strings, redirects and cross-origin calls are refused
GET handlers never poll, import or write; polling and imports run through explicit ingestion operations with exactly one configured import owner per source
requests require bounded Content-Length and application/json UTF-8; chunked upload and invalid or negative lengths are refused
error envelopes carry only code, retryable and request_id; no traceback or path leak
stream identifiers are the local ingest-sequence cursor bound to ledger and filter; replay after Last-Event-ID is at least once and clients dedupe by origin event id and revision
stream heartbeat comment every 15 seconds; reconnect backs off exponentially between 1 and 30 seconds with jitter
unexpected cursor or ledger replacement returns 409 reset_required and the client refetches a bounded snapshot
feedback edits append superseding events; stale concurrent edits return 409; the same idempotency key returns the original result and never duplicates intervention counts
